# Luigi's American Breakfast

> Family-run American breakfast and lunch restaurant in Redmond Ridge, Washington. Known for Swedish pancakes, eggs benedict, breakfast burritos, scrambles, burgers, sandwiches, and daily breakfast service.

## Menu highlights

- Swedish Pancakes — house specialty with fresh Devonshire cream and jam
- Eggs Benedict — brunch classic with hollandaise and breakfast sides
- Breakfast Burrito — carne asada or homemade chorizo with scrambled eggs, peppers, and red potatoes
- Pancakes, French toast, scrambles, omelets, burgers, sandwiches, kids menu, and drinks
